1.t: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺

2.t: until you end up in ˹your˺ graves

3.t: But no! You will soon come to know

4.t: Again, no! You will soon come to know

5.t: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺

6.t: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire

7.t: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

8.t: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures
